name: ChartEditBench
intro: ChartEditBench 是一个面向多轮图表编辑的基准，要求模型在连续对话中维护共同上下文、根据视觉反馈修改代码并完成图表更新，用于评估 grounded chart editing 能力。
build_method: 37图型固定种子初图生成, 五轮递增修改, 17样式/18数据修改轮询, 四步执行验证, Chart-R1与双断言, 400实例双专家验证
metric: Execution Rate, Instruction Following Score, Code Quality Score, Visual Similarity Score, Overall Score
modality: 图像, 文本, 代码, 多模态
task_type: 多轮图表编辑, 代码生成
eval_feature: Code-to-Code与NL Delta双任务, 模型自身预测逐轮传递, 失败回退, 程序断言与Chart-R1混合评分
scale: 4,142个实例, 20,710次修改, 37种图型, 35种修改, 400实例人工验证子集
intro_en: ChartEditBench evaluates grounded multi-turn chart editing in multimodal language models. It measures whether models can keep common ground, update plotting code, and follow iterative editing instructions over time.
build_method_en: Fixed-seed Initial Generation over 37 Chart Types, Progressive Five-turn Edits, 17-style/18-data Round Robin, Four-step Execution Validation, Chart-R1 and Dual Assertions, 400-instance Two-expert Review
metric_en: Execution Rate, Instruction Following Score, Code Quality Score, Visual Similarity Score, Overall Score
eval_feature_en: Code-to-Code and NL Delta Tasks, Own-prediction Turn Chaining, Failure Fallback, Programmatic Assertion and Chart-R1 Hybrid Scoring
scale_en: 4,142 instances, 20,710 modifications, 37 chart types, 35 edit types, 400-instance human-verified subset
flowchart_zh:
flowchart LR
    A["从真实图表与表格任务中构造初始图表状态"] --> B["为每个样本设计连续多轮修改指令链"]
    B --> C["按程序化指令与语义指令控制难度与类型"]
    C --> D["保留人工核验子集校正噪声与歧义"]
    D --> E["让模型逐轮生成或修改绘图代码"]
    E --> F["执行代码并渲染图表结果"]
    F --> G["同时计算执行率、指令遵循、视觉相似度与逻辑代码验证"]
    G --> H["分析多轮累积误差与上下文断裂问题"]
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Build initial chart states from real chart and table tasks"] --> B["Design sequential multi-turn edit chains for each sample"]
    B --> C["Control difficulty with programmatic and semantic edit instructions"]
    C --> D["Keep a human-verified subset to correct noise and ambiguity"]
    D --> E["Ask models to generate or revise plotting code turn by turn"]
    E --> F["Execute the code and render the resulting chart"]
    F --> G["Measure execution rate, instruction following, visual similarity, and logical code verification"]
    G --> H["Analyze cumulative errors and common-ground failures in multi-turn editing"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2602.15758. The diagram preserves the three generation stages; 37 matplotlib chart types in six categories with fixed seeds; five increasingly difficult dependent edits; 17 style and 18 data modification types under round-robin balancing; five VQA pairs per rendered chart; AST, isolated 60-second execution, render, and required-structure gates with up to three retries; Chart-R1 code-to-code and chart-to-chart verification; 3-4 instruction and 4-8 requirement assertions per turn; two-expert review of 400 stratified instances with Cohen's kappa; the final 4,142 instances and 20,710 modifications rather than the abstract-level 5,000 target; Code-to-Code and Natural-language Delta tasks; own-prediction conversational chaining with fallback; and Execution, Instruction Following, Code Quality, Visual Similarity, and Overall scores.
